metadata.question: Did the Jianghan District of Wuhan show lower nightime light intensity on February 4, 2020, compared to January 19, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Primary: NASA Black Marble daily VIIRS VNP46A2 around the target dates (Jan 19, 2020 and Feb 4, 2020) over a polygon approximating Jianghan District, Wuhan. - If no images on exact day, widen to ±1 day. If still none, fallback to monthly NOAA/VIIRS VCMSLCFG for Jan-2020 and Feb-2020. 2. Masking strategy: - Prefer cloud mask using QF_Cloud_Mask if present (mask == 0 interpreted as clear). - Always require radiance > 0 and finite. Count valid pixels; compute valid% as proxy for cloud obscuration. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - If collection size == 0 after attempts → C1. - If valid pixel count == 0 after masking → C2. - If mean is null/NaN or outside plausible range (<=0 or > 10000 nW/cm2/sr) → C3. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Approximate polygon covering Jianghan District, Wuhan (small central urban area) const geom = ee.Geometry.Polygon( [[[114.245, 30.585], [114.245, 30.635], [114.315, 30.635], [114.315, 30.585]]], null, false ); const dateA = '2020-01-19'; const dateB = '2020-02-04'; const areaKm2 = ee.Number(geom.area(1)).divide(1e6).getInfo(); console.log(`AOI area (km2): ${areaKm2.toFixed(2)}`); function pickFirstPresentBand(bandList, candidates) { for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) { if (bandList.indexOf(candidates[i]) !== -1) return candidates[i]; } return null; } function safeGet(obj) { try { return obj.getInfo(); } catch (e) { return null; } } function getDailyStats(dateStr, label) { // Try daily Black Marble (VNP46A2) let result = { source: null, // 'daily' or 'monthly' dateStr: dateStr, window: null, images: 0, mean: null, validCount: 0, totalCount: 0, status: 'OK' }; try { // exact day let start = ee.Date(dateStr); let end = start.advance(1, 'day'); let col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A2') .filterBounds(geom) .filterDate(start, end); let size0 = col.size().getInfo(); let windowNote = '±0d'; // widen by ±1 day if empty if (size0 === 0) { const start2 = start.advance(-1, 'day'); const end2 = start.advance(2, 'day'); col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A2') .filterBounds(geom) .filterDate(start2, end2); windowNote = '±1d'; } const size = col.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) { // Fallback to monthly result.status = 'C1'; } else { result.source = 'daily'; result.window = windowNote; result.images = size; let img = col.median(); const bandNames = img.bandNames().getInfo(); const radBand = pickFirstPresentBand(bandNames || [], [ 'DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL', // common in VNP46A2 'Gap_Filled_DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL', 'Nadir_Radiance', 'Radiance' ]); if (!radBand) { result.status = 'D'; return result; } // Build mask: positive radiance and clear cloud if QF exists let rad = img.select(radBand); let mask = rad.gt(0); const qfBand = pickFirstPresentBand(bandNames || [], ['QF_Cloud_Mask', 'Cloud_Mask', 'Mandatory_Quality_Flag']); if (qfBand) { // Interpret 0 as clear for QF_Cloud_Mask-style bands const qf = img.select(qfBand); mask = mask.and(qf.eq(0)); } rad = rad.updateMask(mask); const validCount = safeGet( rad.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(radBand) ); if (validCount === null) { result.status = 'C3'; return result; } result.validCount = validCount || 0; const totalCount = safeGet( ee.Image.constant(1).rename('ones').clip(geom).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('ones') ); result.totalCount = totalCount || 0; if (result.validCount === 0) { result.status = 'C2'; return result; } const mean = safeGet( rad.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(radBand) ); result.mean = mean; if (mean === null || isNaN(mean) || mean <= 0 || mean > 10000) { result.status = 'C3'; return result; } } } catch (e) { // If dataset/band error, mark D to try monthly fallback next result.status = 'D'; } return result; } function getMonthlyStats(monthStr) { // monthStr in 'YYYY-MM' (use for Jan and Feb 2020) let result = { source: 'monthly', month: monthStr, images: 0, mean: null, validCount: 0, totalCount: 0, status: 'OK' }; try { const start = ee.Date(`${monthStr}-01`); const end = start.advance(1, 'month'); let mcol = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterBounds(geom) .filterDate(start, end); const msize = mcol.size().getInfo(); result.images = msize; if (msize === 0) { result.status = 'C1'; return result; } let mimg = ee.Image(mcol.first()); const bands = mimg.bandNames().getInfo(); const radBand = bands && bands.indexOf('avg_rad') !== -1 ? 'avg_rad' : null; if (!radBand) { result.status = 'D'; return result; } const rad = mimg.select(radBand); const validCount = safeGet( rad.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(radBand) ); result.validCount = validCount || 0; const totalCount = safeGet( ee.Image.constant(1).rename('ones').clip(geom).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('ones') ); result.totalCount = totalCount || 0; if (result.validCount === 0) { result.status = 'C2'; return result; } const mean = safeGet( rad.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(radBand) ); result.mean = mean; if (mean === null || isNaN(mean) || mean <= 0 || mean > 10000) { result.status = 'C3'; return result; } } catch (e) { result.status = 'D'; } return result; } function printStats(label, res) { if (res.source === 'daily') { const validPct = res.totalCount > 0 ? (100 * res.validCount / res.totalCount) : 0; console.log(`${label} Daily VNP46A2 ${res.dateStr} images: ${res.images} (window ${res.window})`); console.log(`${label} Mean: ${res.mean !== null ? res.mean.toFixed(3) : 'null'}, Valid px: ${res.validCount}/${res.totalCount} (${validPct.toFixed(1)}%)`); } else if (res.source === 'monthly') { const validPct = res.totalCount > 0 ? (100 * res.validCount / res.totalCount) : 0; console.log(`${label} Monthly VCMSLCFG ${res.month} images: ${res.images}`); console.log(`${label} Mean: ${res.mean !== null ? res.mean.toFixed(3) : 'null'}, Valid px: ${res.validCount}/${res.totalCount} (${validPct.toFixed(1)}%)`); } else { console.log(`${label} Status: ${res.status}`); } } // Process A (Jan 19, 2020) let A = getDailyStats(dateA, 'A'); if (A.status !== 'OK') { // Fallback to monthly for Jan 2020 const Am = getMonthlyStats('2020-01'); if (Am.status === 'OK') { A = { ...Am, source: 'monthly' }; } else { printStats('A', A); console.log(Am.status); return; } } // Process B (Feb 4, 2020) let B = getDailyStats(dateB, 'B'); if (B.status !== 'OK') { // Fallback to monthly for Feb 2020 const Bm = getMonthlyStats('2020-02'); if (Bm.status === 'OK') { B = { ...Bm, source: 'monthly' }; } else { printStats('B', B); console.log(Bm.status); return; } } // Print concise evidence printStats('A', A); printStats('B', B); // Decision and failure handling function finalFailureTag(obj) { if (obj.status === 'C1') return 'C1'; if (obj.status === 'C2') return 'C2'; if (obj.status === 'C3') return 'C3'; if (obj.status === 'D') return 'D'; return null; } const failA = finalFailureTag(A); const failB = finalFailureTag(B); if (failA) { console.log(failA); return; } if (failB) { console.log(failB); return; } const meanA = A.mean; const meanB = B.mean; if (meanA === null || meanB === null || isNaN(meanA) || isNaN(meanB)) { console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare: Was Feb 4 lower than Jan 19? const answer = (meanB < meanA) ? 'A' : 'B'; console.log(answer); } catch (e) { // Any unexpected runtime issue console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
